episodios.titulo: 5 erros de inglês que todo brasileiro comete
temas: I have 20 years -> I am 20 years old
I pretend to travel -> I plan to travel
Can I make a question? -> Can I ask a question?
ensina: I plan to travel next year.

ensina: I borrow books from the library.

episodios.titulo: 5 frases de inglês para o aeroporto e a imigração
temas: Motivo da viagem? 🛂 Passeio = vacation -> I'm here on vacation.
Gate = portão de embarque ✈️ -> Where is the gate?
Nada a declarar = nothing to declare 🧳 -> I have nothing to declare.
Layover = escala ⏱️ -> How long is the layover?
Luggage = bagagem 🧳 · suitcase = mala -> My luggage is lost.
ensina: I'm here on vacation for two weeks.
Excuse me, where is gate twelve?
I'm only carrying clothes and a few gifts.
The layover in Dallas is three hours.
My suitcase didn't arrive. Can you help me?
